lines.text: Never watched basketball? Just ask your TV.
This is Your Own Commentator on Fire TV. Pick a game, then pick your commentator.
The Rookie commentator explains each rule the moment it matters.
Same game, same play, a different commentator. Seven of them, in four languages.
A two-voice booth, or a fantasy analyst tracking points.
Pause and ask why. Replays and the minimap come from our own computer vision.
Missed a minute? Catch up. Friends join from their own homes and call the next basket.
Under the hood: Amazon Nova Pro reads the game, Nova 2 Lite writes, Nova Sonic hears your question, and Polly speaks. Every line passes fact gates in code.
Video-only AI was right 5 times in 182, so every score is anchored to the broadcast score graphic. Zero invented plays in 494 lines.
Most amateur games have no commentary at all. Now every viewer gets their own broadcast.
